name: National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme
benefit: - **Stipend:** A stipend amount of ₹15,000/- per month will be provided for physical internships only. - **Certificate of Internship:** Certificates will be issued to the interns on satisfactory completion of their internship and evaluation of their Report/Paper by the concerned.- **Logistic Support:** MNRE shall provide them with internet facilities and other necessities as deemed fit by the conc
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be pursuing a graduate or post-graduate degree course in Engineering/ Management/ Law/ Science stream/Renewable Energy in a recognized University/institution within India or abroad. OR, - The applicant should be working in the Renewable Energy area in National, International, and Non-Governmental Institutes/organisations. <br> > **NOTE:** MNRE will have the power to relax any of the above conditions mentioned, in respect of any deserving candidate.
